_comment: I0 provider playbook (schema: app/domain/playbook.py). Public facts only, every claim sourced. Paxos freezes or seizes only on a formal legal directive from a regulator, judicial body or LE agency with jurisdiction over Paxos (or a partner's contractual notification, or its own discretion); a victim / PI reports through the support center and goes to LE. The LE / subpoena e-mail on the contact page is not catalogued until its local part is reviewed (directory.EMAIL_LOCAL_PARTS): null here.
notes: Issuers by token: USDP and PYUSD by Paxos Trust Company (US, OCC); USDG jointly by Paxos Digital Singapore (MAS) and Paxos Issuance Europe Oy (Finland, FIN-FSA e-money licence). A freeze can also follow 'a formal notification by a Paxos partner according to previously agreed contractual terms' (for PYUSD presumably PayPal: inferred, not named), or Paxos' own discretion. Freezes may happen with or without advance notice. On-chain the token contracts emit AddressFrozen / FrozenAddressWiped (medium confidence, contract design); app/freeze does not read Paxos tokens yet, so a person confirms a freeze on the explorer.

channels.label: Paxos support center (complaints, reports of illegal activity)
channels.notes: Anyone aware of improper conduct is told to contact Paxos here and also contact law enforcement to file a report. Complaints also go here as a support request.

channels.label: Law-enforcement inquiries and subpoenas
channels.notes: Paxos' contact page publishes an e-mail address 'for law enforcement inquiries or subpoenas'. Not catalogued yet (its local part needs review): add it as a verified case or global channel after checking the page. Acts only on a formal legal directive or court-ordered subpoena.

instrument.notes: Paxos asks reporters to contact law enforcement as well: give the police / IC3 reference.

paths.notes: Name the token (USDP / PYUSD / USDG), chain and each address. A freeze is not expected without a directive; the value is the flag while the funds sit and the ticket number for the LE request. Brief the LE officer as soon as the ticket arrives.

instrument.notes: A formal legal directive from a regulator, judicial body, law-enforcement agency or other legal entity having jurisdiction over Paxos, naming the addresses.

paths.notes: Precedent: in Nov 2022 Paxos froze PAXG at four addresses on a US federal law-enforcement direction (reported). No published response time.

instrument.notes: A court order or other legal process from a court with jurisdiction over Paxos (court-ordered subpoenas are a listed format).

paths.notes: Paxos freezes 'if required to do so by law, including by court order or other legal process'.

instrument.notes: Court-ordered subpoena, national security letter or a regulator's formal written directive.
A binding formal written legal directive (seizure / forfeiture); never without one.

paths.notes: Seized funds are held in a segregated wallet until disposed of as the law requires; the contract can wipe a frozen address (FrozenAddressWiped, medium). Return to victims follows the court process.

instrument.notes: A non-US authority has no jurisdiction over Paxos Trust (USDP, PYUSD): MLAT or a US counterpart agency.

paths.notes: Slow (months): pair it with a US agency or US counsel while the funds sit.

instrument.notes: USDG only: an EU judicial authority sends a Reg. (EU) 2018/1805 freezing certificate to Finland, where Paxos Issuance Europe is licensed.

paths.notes: Inferred route from USDG's EU co-issuer; not stated by Paxos. USDP / PYUSD are US-issued: use mlat_us.
